title: Keep tests independent
summary: A test should set up the state it needs. Cypress test isolation helps avoid state leaking from a previous test.
introduction: A test should set up the state it needs. Cypress test isolation helps avoid state leaking from a previous test. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
